title: Scarlet Watch Post

[[image:Scarlet Watch Post.jpg|thumb|Scarlet Watch Post]]
The '''Scarlet Watch Post''' is a guard tower located in northeastern [[Tirisfal Glades]], just north of the [[Scarlet Monastery]]. Its maintenance despite its remote location is solely to prevent enemies of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] from assaulting the monastery from its less defensible north side.
